target.name: High pressure hydrogen Type IV storage tank production

strategy.label: transcription drafted from the report excerpt by the LLM pipeline (reverse-bafu draft)
strategy.note: basis: Table 36 'Life cycle inventories to produce a high-pressure Type IV hydrogen tank. Storage capacity of 10 kg', column 'high pressure hydrogen storage tank/GLO U', per 1 p; allocation: none stated. Review every derivation; unreviewed entries have reviewed_by = null.

evidence.source: 2024 - LCA power-to-X in residential sector - Sacchi.pdf

gaps_reported_by_model: No copper metal input is listed, only 'Sheet rolling, copper' - the copper itself appears to be missing from the table as printed (the aluminium, chromium steel and low-alloyed steel each have both a material and a rolling line).
No direct emissions of any kind.
No end-of-life / disposal of the tank.
No plant infrastructure for the tank factory.
The weaved carbon fibre is a linked dataset (Table 35, reproduced on p.63) rather than an elementary flow; its own energy, steam and emissions are inside it.
